Congress split over the vote on a war power resolution that would force President Trump to abandon the Iran war. The House of Representatives advanced the Iran war powers resolution with a vote of 214 to 208, while the Senate rejected the resolution by a 49-to-47 vote.

ranked_evidence.title: India’s Cockroach protests: Rahul Gandhi detained after calling for PM Modi to resign - The Guardian
ranked_evidence.snippet: Opposition leader taken away after accusing Narendra Modi of ‘destroying the future of India’s youth’ during protest in solidarity with cockroach movement. Indian police briefly detained opposition leader Rahul Gandhi on Tuesday during protests calling for prime minister Narendra Modi’s resignation, in solidarity with the new youth-led cockroach party movement. Gandhi, the leader of India’s Congress party, staged a sit-in outside Modi’s house on Tuesday afternoon, stating that Modi must resign “for destroying the future of India’s youth”. His protest took place as thousands of students were gathered at a separate site in central Delhi, the day after a huge protest calling for the resignation of Modi’s education minister was met with brutality by Delhi police, including baton attacks and teargas. Gandhi said his party was taking their protest directly to the prime minister’s house, after the Modi government refused to take up the issues of the students and the alleged “brutality unleashed on students” in parliament.
